name: Suppress Application Icon
summary: A malicious application could suppress its icon from being displayed to the user in the application launcher. This hides the fact that it is installed, and can make it more difficult for the user to uninstall the application. Hiding the application's icon programmatically does not require any special permissions. This behavior has been seen in the BankBot/Spy Banker family of malware. evidence.description: FlexiSpy is capable of hiding SuperSU's icon if it is installed and visible. FlexiSpy can also hide its own icon to make detection and the uninstallation process more difficult.
